CLASSIFY::defer
Description
This command defers the classification of the flow to response (for
HTTP - response message, for non-HTTP, opposite traffic direction from
traffic initiator)
Note: the Policy Enforcement Manager license is required for
functionality to work.
Syntax
CLASSIFY
::
defer
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
FLOW_INIT
